subject: TileFin POC — integration checklist, owners & proposed timeline
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta@tilefintech.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@tilefintech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: TileFin POC — integration checklist, owners & proposed timeline

Hi Marta / Tom — thanks for the call earlier. Quick written recap and a proposal for next steps so we can get your POC started without surprises. Attaching a short POC checklist and our SDK guide.

Summary of call (top-line):
- Scope: 2-week sandbox POC to validate: (1) end-to-end inference latency and throughput for core fraud-detection prompts, (2) streaming reliability for incremental scoring, (3) tool-calling for enrichment lookups.
- Environment: TileFin wants a VPC/private-endpoint test with data flow staying inside your cloud account (no tokens persisted outside).
- Success criteria: see proposed list below.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
1) 99th- percentile end-to-end inference latency < 250ms at 150 rps sustained (generation truncation to 256 tokens).
2) Streaming responses with less than 1% frame-failure rate over 24h stability window.
3) Tool-calling integration works for the three enrichment endpoints (customer_match, sanctions_check, real_time_score) with end-to-end round-trip < 400ms.
4) No PII leakage in logs; SOC2 artifacts available for review.
5) Integration completed by TileFin engineering with Redwood support; acceptance test passing (defined test prompts) within 4 weeks of kickoff.

Proposed team & ownership:
- TileFin: Tom Reed (eng lead, implementation), Marta Silva (product success criteria).
- Redwood: Dev Patel (integration lead), Rishi Malhotra (SRE / infra lead), Lauren Bishop (commercial/CS lead).

High-level timeline (flexible):
Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access & networking (VPC peering / private link), share credentials, confirm test dataset.
Week 1: SDK integration and basic generate/chat routes. Confirm streaming path.
Week 2: Tool-calling wiring + end-to-end repeatable tests. Load test and stability run.
Week 3: Acceptance tests and review; iterate on tuning.

Tech notes for your eng team (detail we covered on call):
- SDK endpoints: /v1/generate (sync), /v1/chat/stream (event-stream for token-by-token), tool-calling via function signatures in chat messages.
- Auth: short-lived key + optional mTLS for private endpoints.
- Caching: we recommend KV prefix caching for repeated user prompts — we can surface suggested cache keys after initial run.

Immediate asks from TileFin to unblock kickoff:
1) Confirm we can get a VPC/private endpoint (yes/no) and the contact for networking.
2) Confirm a small set of representative prompts + a sandbox dataset.
3) Agree a kickoff slot (propose Thu Jul 9, 15:00 UTC).

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx, sdk-integration-guide.pdf

Thanks — I’ll update the checklist after your reply and share a one-sheet acceptance test plan.

—
Dev Patel
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
From: Marta Silva <marta@tilefintech.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@tilefintech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: TileFin POC — integration checklist, owners & proposed timeline

Thanks Dev — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side after we regrouped internally:
- VPC/private endpoint: yes, we can provide a PrivateLink endpoint. Networking contact is Diego (diego@tilefintech.com) — I’ll loop him on the kickoff invite.
- Security: Legal will want SOC2 docs and an outline of what logs are retained and where. Can you attach a short summary of your retention / redaction defaults?
- Success criteria: the latency numbers look fine but can we add an accuracy/stability measure? Specifically: F1 improvement on our enrichment signals (baseline vs POC) and <2% inference variance in daily runs.
- Data residency: we’re EU-based, so please ensure any temporary debug logs remain in EU region.

We can do the kickoff Thu Jul 9 15:00 UTC — Tom and I will attend. Also, could you add Diego Fernandez at Redwood as an SRE contact if someone on your side is best to coordinate infra (we have some strict subnet rules to map)?

Marta
Product Manager, TileFintech
marta@tilefintech.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Silva <marta@tilefintech.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@tilefintech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 10:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: TileFin POC — integration checklist, owners & proposed timeline

Appreciate the quick note — adding a few concrete updates based on Marta’s asks.

Security & residency:
- I attached security-evidence-summary.pdf (short 2-pager) outlining SOC2 status, retention defaults, and redaction knobs. For the POC we will enable EU-only telemetry and confirm no Egress to non-EU regions.

Success criteria (revised):
- Latency: 99th Pctl < 250ms at 150 rps (same)
- Streaming: <1% frame-failure rate over 24h
- Tool-calling: end-to-end < 400ms for the three enrichment endpoints
- Accuracy/stability: measurable F1 delta (we will run the POC baseline against your sample set and report F1; target is >5% relative lift OR parity with your production model with lower cost)
- Variance: <2% day-to-day inference variance on identical batch runs

Integration specifics we’ll help with during Week 1: 
- SDK quickstart: npm and pip examples in sdk-integration-guide.pdf. The most common pattern for streaming is: open /v1/chat/stream with chunked-transfer and resume on transient errors via the provided session token.
- Tool calling: describe function schemas to Redwood via POST /v1/tools/register and then include tool hints in chat messages; we’ll provide mock endpoints for you to exercise.
- Auth & network: we’ll create a short-lived key scoped to TileFin POC and enable PrivateLink. Rishi will coordinate mTLS cert exchange with Diego.

Provisional kickoff confirmed: Thu Jul 9 15:00 UTC — I’ll send a calendar invite and include Diego (redwood) + your Diego (tilefin).

Next actions (Dev / TileFin):
- I: Send calendar invite + network pre-reqs doc (today)
- You (Tom): Share sample prompts & a 500-row sandbox dataset by EOD Jul 10
- Marta: Confirm legal contact for SOC2 review

—
Dev Patel
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference

Good progress team — two commercial notes from my side: 
1) Pricing/credits: for a 3–4 week POC we typically provide a usage credit and a short-term commercial agreement (non-recurring). I’ll draft an SOW and include the credit line once we have the expected token volumes (Dev, can you estimate after Tom shares the dataset?).
2) Legal/contract: Marta, please send the legal contact so our contracts team can start a minimal NDA/POC agreement (we generally use a one-page POC MOU). I have a DocuSign template ready; will circulate once legal contact is shared.

Rishi — please be ready to confirm the PrivateLink / mTLS checklist during kickoff. Diego (redwood) — happy to have you lead the infra call as needed.
